competences.description: Inflicts damage that ignores all damage reduction effects to the enemy target and absorbs its Attack Bar by 30%. If the attack lands as a Critical Hit, the Attack Bar absorption amount increases by an additional 20%.
Attacks all enemies and grants 2 Continuous Damage without a turn limit each.

Releases 3 energy beads to attack the enemy that attacked the boss last whenever the boss is attacked 15 times. Each attack decreases the Defense for 2 turns. Afterwards, the boss' Critical Rate increases for 2 turns.
[Automatic Effect]

Attacks all enemies and watches them with Watcher's Eye for 1 turn. While watching the enemies, nullifies damage received and absorbs 15% HP each from enemies that gain a turn. Watcher's Eye is maintained until you are attacked by the enemy 5 times.
